title: Skull's Lazy Megas
description: This is a Cobblemon DataPack that add 27 Megas. Made this project as a hobby. Mostly for fun, so models are not the highest quality since am new.
body:
This Datapack contains 27 custom made Mega Evolutions, 8 new abilities, that are made as a hobby. 

Most are made with competetive in mind, and might be rebalanced from time to time.
Model quality is not the top quality, since this is a hobby project, but might get updated as time goes on.

Document for mega stone recepies, abilities and Added BST are in links WIKI (it's a google doc)

Free to download and change as you wish.

If there is any bugs or oversights on my part, please let me know on Mega Showdown discord support page for my datapack.

Requires Cobblemon and Mega Showdown mods.

Rough Google Dock: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DB-ijCP-CzYgmVEC3U7r_ZyViRDw4CYq/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=102238008540592230587&rtpof=true&sd=true
